Weiher.et: From Middle High German wī(h)er, from earlier wīwære, from Old High German wīwāri, from Proto-West Germanic *wīwārī (“pond”), from Latin vīvārium. Doublet of Vivarium.

Weihrauch.et: From Old High German wīhrouh (“incense”), equivalent to weih (“holy”) + Rauch (“smoke”). Cognate with Dutch wierook (“incense”).
